description: This file defines the ApiProvider class within the Aws\Api namespace. It provides mechanisms to load, resolve, and manage API data for AWS services, including default providers, manifest-based providers, and filesystem-based providers. It includes methods for resolving API data, fetching versions, and handling API model files.

classes.name: ApiProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to resolve, load, and manage AWS API models, supporting multiple provider types such as default, manifest, and filesystem-based providers.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an API provider call with the specified parameters, returning API data or throwing an exception if unresolved.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns a default API provider initialized with the standard data directory and manifest.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Creates a provider based on the specified directory and manifest data.

methods.name: filesystem
methods.description: Creates a provider that loads API models from the specified directory.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves available API versions for a specific service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the provider to load specific API model data based on type, service, and version.
